dedupe_keys.name: dssat decision support system for agrotechnology transfer and cropping system model

description: DSSAT is a software application with crop simulation models for over 45 crops, plus tools to use them. The tools include database managers for soil, weather, crop management and experimental data, utilities and application programs. The models simulate growth, development and yield as a function of soil, plant and atmosphere dynamics, at a daily or sometimes hourly step. Each day they update the plant and soil water, nitrogen, phosphorus and carbon balances and the crop's development stage. Inputs are daily weather, soil surface and profile data, crop management and cultivar information, and multi-year runs test "what if" management strategies. Uses include on-farm and precision management, regional assessment of climate variability and climate change impacts, crop water use, greenhouse gas emissions and bioenergy. Coverage is generic, with users in over 198 countries. Access: the latest version, 4.8.6 (July 2026), is free of charge on request through a download form. Since December 2019 the Cropping System Model code has been open on GitHub under the BSD 3-Clause licence, running on Windows, Linux and Apple systems. Caveats: the desktop suite is Windows-based, and cultivar parameters must be calibrated by the user. For simulation it gives crop yield responses to drought, heat and management for agricultural hazard and adaptation studies, and it is one of the models in the GGCMI ensembles. Related catalogue records include APSIM, PCSE/WOFOST, STICS and the GGCMI outputs.
